description_en: This operation configures a backup policy for an instance. You can set a weekly schedule to back up an instance on specific days, such as every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 20:00:00. You can also specify the number of completed backups to retain. The system automatically deletes expired backups
description_zh: 配置备份策略。以周为周期，可以指定一周内的数个固定日期启动实例备份，比如周一、周三、周五的20:00:00。已完成的备份，可以配置保留个数，过期的备份会被自动清理
kebab_example: aliyun hologram update-scheduled-backup-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id hgprecn-cn-zvp25ysxxxx --enabled true --week 1,3,5 --hour 20 --data-keep-quantity 3 --dst-region cn-beijing --zone-id cn-beijing-i --manual-data-keep-quantity 3 --schedule-type remote --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateScheduledBackupConfig

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to enable scheduled backups. Set this parameter to `true` to enable scheduled backups, or `false` to disable them.
parameters.description_zh: 是否开启周期备份。true 开启，false 关闭。
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable scheduled backups. Set this parameter to `true` to enable scheduled backups, or `false` to disable them
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启周期备份。true 开启，false 关闭
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.description_en: Specifies the days of the week on which to perform a backup. Separate multiple days with commas. For example, to perform backups on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, set this parameter to `1,3,5`.
parameters.description_zh: 备份日期的周配置，可以配置多个，英文逗号分隔，比如配置周一、周三、周五，参数为"1,3,5".
parameters.help_en: Specifies the days of the week on which to perform a backup. Separate multiple days with commas. For example, to perform backups on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, set this parameter to `1,3,5`
parameters.help_zh: 备份日期的周配置，可以配置多个，英文逗号分隔，比如配置周一、周三、周五，参数为"1,3,5"
parameters.name: week

parameters.description_en: The hour to start the backup. This start time applies to all specified days. For example, if you set `week` to `1,3,5` and `hour` to `20`, a backup starts at 20:00:00 every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
parameters.description_zh: 备份日期的开始时间点，备份任务将在开始时间点启动。时间点对所有有效日期生效，比如week配置了1,3,5, hour配置20， 那么，每周一、周三、周五的20:00:00都会开始备份。
parameters.help_en: The hour to start the backup. This start time applies to all specified days. For example, if you set `week` to `1,3,5` and `hour` to `20`, a backup starts at 20:00:00 every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
parameters.help_zh: 备份日期的开始时间点，备份任务将在开始时间点启动。时间点对所有有效日期生效，比如week配置了1,3,5, hour配置20， 那么，每周一、周三、周五的20:00:00都会开始备份
parameters.name: hour

parameters.description_en: The number of scheduled backups to retain. For example, if you set this parameter to `3`, the system retains the three most recent backups and automatically deletes any older ones.
parameters.description_zh: 周期备份保留个数，比如配置3，系统会自动保留最新的3个备份，其余过期备份会被自动清理。
parameters.help_en: The number of scheduled backups to retain. For example, if you set this parameter to `3`, the system retains the three most recent backups and automatically deletes any older ones
parameters.help_zh: 周期备份保留个数，比如配置3，系统会自动保留最新的3个备份，其余过期备份会被自动清理
parameters.name: data_keep_quantity

parameters.description_en: The destination region for the backup. This parameter applies only to remote backups and enables cross-region disaster recovery. For example, you can back up an instance from China (Hangzhou) to China (Beijing).
parameters.description_zh: 备份目标地域。仅对远程备份生效，支持将本地域数据备份到其他地域，实现跨地域容灾。比如杭州的实例，可以跨地域备份到北京。
parameters.help_en: The destination region for the backup. This parameter applies only to remote backups and enables cross-region disaster recovery. For example, you can back up an instance from China (Hangzhou) to China (Beijing)
parameters.help_zh: 备份目标地域。仅对远程备份生效，支持将本地域数据备份到其他地域，实现跨地域容灾。比如杭州的实例，可以跨地域备份到北京
parameters.name: dst_region

parameters.description_en: The destination availability zone for the backup. This parameter applies only to remote backups.
parameters.description_zh: 备份目标可用区。仅对远程备份生效
parameters.help_en: The destination availability zone for the backup. This parameter applies only to remote backups
parameters.help_zh: 备份目标可用区。仅对远程备份生效
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.description_en: The number of manual backups to retain. Manual backups and automatic backups are stored separately and have independent retention policies.
parameters.description_zh: 手动备份保留个数。手动备份和自动备份分开存储，保留策略完全分开。
parameters.help_en: The number of manual backups to retain. Manual backups and automatic backups are stored separately and have independent retention policies
parameters.help_zh: 手动备份保留个数。手动备份和自动备份分开存储，保留策略完全分开
parameters.name: manual_data_keep_quantity

parameters.description_en: The backup type. This parameter is required only for remote backups.
parameters.description_zh: 备份类型。仅远程备份需要配置此字段，其余类型可以忽略。
parameters.help_en: The backup type. This parameter is required only for remote backups
parameters.help_zh: 备份类型。仅远程备份需要配置此字段，其余类型可以忽略
parameters.name: schedule_type
